issues.reason: `Ongoing` has exactly four licensed markers (auxiliary progressive, continuative perfect, inceptive complement, perception-verb participle) and the participle of a reduced relative is none of them, so the atom asserts an aspect the clause never marks.

gaps_confirmed: proper-noun organization modifier of a common noun denoting affiliation ("a Tenet spokesman", "a Redding Medical Center official") — the name-plus-common-noun rule only covers a named entity that IS that kind, so nothing licenses the affiliation link
new_gaps: a reduced-relative modifier on an object inside a strength-0 denial ("did not return telephone calls seeking comment") — nothing states whether the modifying event falls under the denial or projects out of it

a bare-plural object rendered as the bare class symbol (`telephone_call`) and then used as the role filler of its own modifying event — the bare-class licence is written for unmodified generic objects
repair_summary: Removed the unlicensed (Ongoing sk_seek_1) from the strength-0 bundle, leaving the seek event with its class and roles and no status atom (the unmarked default).
notes: `Possession` for the two organization modifiers is opaque and true of the sentence, so it stands as acceptable improvisation in the gap the reviewer names; the control-verb handling of "declined to comment" is correct.
